_about: UI21 (2026-11-05, IDEA-EARLY-3): the one keyword each early map (Maps 0-5) and its side maps introduces. Shown as its own section in the Map cards window (keyword, its rules text, the map's cards that have it); it changes no list, pack or card. Chosen from what each map's lists lean on (card counts below, 2026-11-05). Keys are map ids, values are skill keys.

why.mf: Map 1: Quick on 2 of 17 (ties with True Sight; Flying leads but is Map 3's)
why.mq: Map 1 side map: True Sight (keenEye) on 1 of 13
why.mp: Map 2 side map: Venomous on 2 of 13
why.mg: Map 2 side map: Armor on 3 of 15
